import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a bar plot

sns.barplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Adding titles and labels

plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', data=df, palette='viridis')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day and Type')
